top_signals.title: Oil Prices Fall as Fears of a Global Supply Glut Return
top_signals.summary: Oil prices began the week with a further loss amid reports that the global oil market is returning to oversupply, even as attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz continue and Iraq is forced to export crude by truck via Syria. Brent crude was trading at $95.24 per barrel at the time of writing, and West Texas Intermediate was trading at $88.31 per barrel, both slightly down from Friday’s close. The dip followed a report from the International Energy Agency saying that the oil market will swing back into oversupply during the current quarter.…
